fusions.name: Hauled Mesh
fusions.desc: Casts a 5-tile line of edged mesh ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 11 damage to each one it catches, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cut From the Mesh
fusions.desc: A chop that deals 16 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one. It leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gather the Catch
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 4 seconds. An escort of spinning edges fights beside you for 7 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Snared for the Swing
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict an enemy, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
